caption:
He spent half of every year in the US, and half running free surgery camps across India. For over 40 years.

Dr. Sharad Kumar Dixit emigrated from Maharashtra to the US in 1959 and founded "The India Project" in 1968, personally performing over 65,000 free cleft lip, cleft palate and eye surgeries across India. He kept running the camps after a 1978 car accident left him wheelchair-bound, and later through laryngeal cancer and two heart attacks. India awarded him the Padma Shri in 2001; he was nominated for the Nobel Peace Prize eight times.

A wheelchair couldn't stop the camps. Neither could cancer, two heart attacks, or forty years of plane tickets.

Sources: Wikipedia, World of Children Award
